candidate_relations.label: Pilomatrixoma, deep dermis
candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record describes a classic pilomatricoma (basophilic cells and shadow cells, chalky-white lobulated deep dermal nodule) but the distinctive feature is the bullous/bulla-like presentation with multilocular spaces and dilated lymphatic vessels above the tumor creating the red bulla-like appearance. C001 captures the parent entity and anatomical depth but does not specify the bullous variant, which is the required specificity in the benchmark reference 'Bullous pilomatricoma'.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Identifies the core tumor entity and anatomical location but omits the 'bullous' subtype designation, which is the defining clinical variant in this case

case_quality_flags: Bullous pilomatricoma is a rare morphological variant; the histological findings of dilated lymphatic vessels above the tumor explaining the bulla-like gross appearance are well-documented in the record and support the specific subtype designation.
